summary.text: Aaron Lieberman is the Democratic candidate for Arizona State Senate District 4 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Carine Werner.
He served in the Arizona House of Representatives, representing District 28, from 2019 to September 2021.

paragraphs.text: Lieberman lives in Phoenix, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as founding Acelero Learning and Jumpstart, working as CEO of Phoenix Spine, and teaching with Head Start.
Lieberman won election to the Arizona House in District 28 in 2018 and was re-elected in 2020.

He left office on September 20, 2021, and during 2021 and 2022 he was assigned to the Natural Resources, Energy and Water and Appropriations committees; earlier he had served on Appropriations and Education.
Ballotpedia lists him as a candidate in the 2022 Democratic primary for Governor of Arizona, in which he is recorded as having unofficially withdrawn.
